business_meaning: Surrogate key referencing the account-version in pres.DimSavingsAccount
documented_rules: Every Fact row must reference an existing SavingsAccountSK in pres.DimSavingsAccount;Surrogate keys follow the *Sk naming convention in the domain.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null and match an existing pres.DimSavingsAccount.SavingsAccountSK (referential integrity);Used to join fact to the SCD2 account version.

business_meaning: Natural/business account number assigned to the savings account
documented_rules: AccountNumber is the natural key and must be present in curate and DimSavingsAccount;AccountNumber is unique per account version.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null;When present should match the AccountNumber for the referenced SavingsAccountSK in pres.DimSavingsAccount (consistency between FK and natural key);May repeat across SCD2 versions of the same account.

business_meaning: Surrogate date key in YYYYMMDD format linking to DimDate
documented_rules: All DateSK columns must reference an existing row in DimDate;FactSavingsAccount.DateSK equals the snapshot date (YYYYMMDD) and is taken from Curate.ValidFrom when loading.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null;Must correspond to a valid calendar date in DimDate;Should not be a future date relative to load;Represents the snapshot date for the Balance and InterestRate.

business_meaning: ETL load timestamp for the fact row (populated from Curate.ValidFrom)
documented_rules: Fact tables include LoadDate and it records the ETL load time;FactSavingsAccount.LoadDate is populated from Curate.ValidFrom during the load process.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null;Should reflect the Curate.ValidFrom used for the snapshot;Used for auditing/reconciliation of loads.

business_meaning: Daily snapshot ledger balance for the account-version on DateSK (currency, typically GBP)
documented_rules: Balance must be populated for FactSavingsAccount rows;If AccountStatus = CLOSED then Balance must be 0.00.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null;Should be >= 0.00 unless domain allows overdraft (NOT documented);Should reconcile with adjacent-day balances (ClosingBalance on D = OpeningBalance on D+1) and with transaction running balances.

business_meaning: Annual interest rate applicable to the account-version on the snapshot date (percent)
documented_rules: InterestRate is mandatory in the domain model and is captured per account-version and/or per daily fact row.
inferred_rules: Must be non-null;Should be within a sensible range (>= 0.00 and realistically <= 100.00);Should align to the product/account-version effective date for correct historical attribution.
